lines.text: Bruh, their firewall is a joke.
lines.context: Discovering a target network's weak security

lines.text: Nah. Hard pass. Not touching that.
lines.context: Refusing a job that feels like a setup

lines.text: Wait — wait — did you just say government?
lines.context: Realizing a client works for a federal agency

lines.text: Lowkey don't trust anyone over thirty.
lines.context: Explaining his paranoia to a new contact

lines.text: I dunno. Dunno. Ask someone else.
lines.context: Clamming up when pressed about his real name

lines.text: Yo, so anyway — sick meme yesterday, right?
lines.context: Lying by rapidly changing the subject with humor

lines.text: You literally just used 'synergy' unironically.
lines.context: Deflecting a corporate pitch he finds absurd

lines.text: ARE YOU SERIOUS right now? Deadass?
lines.context: Learning someone sold his exploit to a rival

lines.text: No. NO. That's MY code. MINE.
lines.context: Discovering someone claimed credit for his work

lines.text: Bro I will BRICK your whole setup.
lines.context: Threatening someone who crossed him online

lines.text: Delete it. DELETE it. I'm not asking.
lines.context: Demanding someone remove leaked screenshots of his face

lines.text: Touch my rig and I swear — SWEAR — it's over.
lines.context: Warning someone away from his computer setup

lines.text: You got PLAYED and you don't even know it.
lines.context: Yelling at an ally who fell for a phishing attack

lines.text: No cap, their 'encryption' is just base64.
lines.context: Laughing at a company's security claims

lines.text: Oh wow, a password. I'm shaking. Terrified.
lines.context: Mocking a login screen before bypassing it

lines.text: Yeah that's totally how VPNs work — in a movie.
lines.context: Correcting someone who misunderstands networking

lines.text: Lol sure, 'military grade.' So, like, lowest bidder.
lines.context: Mocking marketing language on a security product

lines.text: Come on come on come on — load, LOAD.
lines.context: Waiting for a file transfer to complete before getting traced

lines.text: They're tracing me — nah nah nah — not yet.
lines.context: Realizing a counter-hack is tracking his location

lines.text: I need like five more seconds. Five. FIVE.
lines.context: Racing to finish a data extraction before lockout

lines.text: Don't cut the power — don't — I lose everything.
lines.context: Begging someone not to shut down his server mid-transfer

lines.text: 'Thought leader.' Bruh, you lead zero thoughts.
lines.context: Roasting a LinkedIn influencer's bio

lines.text: Ohhh big scary suit man with a PowerPoint.
lines.context: Mocking an executive who tried to intimidate him

lines.text: Wow you can copy-paste. Truly elite hacking.
lines.context: Ridiculing a script kiddie who claims to be a hacker

lines.text: Nah, tell me more about your 'blockchain revolution.' I'm RIVETED.
lines.context: Sarcastically engaging with a crypto evangelist

lines.text: Three nodes — proxy chain — bounce through Seoul.
lines.context: Mapping out an anonymized attack route

lines.text: Their API rate-limits at fifty per sec. Easy.
lines.context: Identifying a vulnerability in a target's infrastructure

lines.text: Port 443, open. 8080, filtered. SSH on 2222.
lines.context: Reading off a port scan to a collaborator

lines.text: Sometimes I think the screen's the only thing that gets me.
lines.context: Alone at 3 AM, talking to himself after a failed social interaction

lines.text: I'm fifteen. I just — I don't wanna do this forever.
lines.context: Admitting to a mentor figure that he's scared of the life he's in
